parameters.content:
## Kettle 4: Low Stock
Every morning at 7:00, in code (no AI). For every product: units sold per day over 28 days, days of stock left, the day it runs out and the last day to order. It flags anything that will run out before a delivery could arrive (supplier lead time plus a safety buffer) and suggests a reorder quantity: enough for the lead time plus 30 days, never below the supplier's minimum. The check is saved in **Kettle Reports**; the owner gets an email only when something is low.
